description: ACR-13 USS Montana, Tennessee-class armored cruiser, 504 ft, 1917 booklet (maritime.org acr13.pdf, 9 plates). Coal-fired, twin 10-in superfiring turret pairs fore and aft, 6-in casemate battery, ~1000 crew wartime. Officers' country aft on gun and berth decks; enlisted berthing fwd; machinery plant (boiler, engine, dynamo rooms) amidships on upper platform; magazines and torpedo rooms on both platforms.
